caravan.citation: Kratzert, F. et al. Caravan - A global community dataset for large-sample hydrology. Scientific Data (2023).
caravan.intended_use: external benchmark and a worked example of large-sample dataset packaging; not an MLET input
caravan.not_ingested_because: Caravan is streamflow-keyed by gauged basin, and MLET is keyed by weather grid cell and flux-tower station, so no MLET evaluation target maps onto a Caravan entity

known_defects.reason: the ERA5-Land native potential-evaporation band is unreliable; Caravan v1.5 added an FAO Penman-Monteith PET variable specifically to replace it. Any MLET fallback to ERA5-Land meteorology must not use the native PET band.

caravan_multimet.citation: Caravan MultiMet: Extending Caravan with Multiple Weather Nowcasts and Forecasts.
caravan_multimet.license: follows the Caravan licence for derived products
caravan_multimet.intended_use: reference convention for pairing observed forcings with multiple forecast products at a fixed issue time, which is the packaging problem MLET currently solves ad hoc for GEFS
caravan_multimet.not_ingested_because: same entity-key mismatch as Caravan; adopted as a layout convention rather than as data

neuralhydrology.citation: Kratzert, F. et al. NeuralHydrology - A Python library for Deep Learning research in hydrology. Journal of Open Source Software (2022).
neuralhydrology.intended_use: source of ported reference implementations and adopted design patterns; see docs/methods/NEURALHYDROLOGY_PROVENANCE.md
neuralhydrology.not_ingested_because: a software library, not a dataset; the ported code is vendored under src/mlet/reference/ with its licence notice
